concept.hr: Izvlačenje imena bez ponavljanja, dok svi ne dođu na red
concept.en: Drawing names without repeats until everyone has had a turn

summary.hr: Zalijepi popis do 30 imena i izvlači jedno po jedno; odabrani ne dolaze ponovno na red dok ne počne novi krug.
summary.en: Paste a list of up to 30 names and draw them one at a time; nobody comes up again until a new round starts.
